notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1.0
notes.content: [p][b]Greetings, heroes! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch 1.1.0[/b] is now live. This patch adds a new unlockable hero, [b]Hector of the shining helm[/b]. Hector has [b]unlimited retaliations[/b] in combat, and gains a [b]20% defense bonus[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 1.1.0 also contains several bugfixes, balance updates, and polish improvements. See the full patch notes below for a detailed list of changes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/a2b0bf0c7f0802463c926089c73a24f717d90fce.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Added Hector, [/b]the legendary Trojan warrior! Hector's Talent [b]Shining Helm[/b] grants him an innate +20% bonus defense and unlimited retaliations. Use these abilities to protect your units, or win glory for yourself in battle![/p][/*][*][p]Updated Kudos tooltip in Hero panel to clarify the function of kudos[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced cost of "Mend" prophecy from 10 to 8 Kudos [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced base duration of "Synthesize" from 1 to 0.5 turns, and reduced zeal-scaling duration of "Synthesize" from 0.5 to 0.34[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked color balance and saturation of ground tiles slightly so that units show up more clearly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the starting prophecy tooltip in Odyssey setup did not properly account for hero's starting Zeal and Epithet modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rounding behavior on prophecy durations from banker's rounding (round .5 to nearest even number) to positive rounding (round .5 to larger number)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated prophecy "Skepticism" to now remove enemy buffs, in addition to removing debuffs from allies. Kudos cost has been increased to 12 to match the increased power.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips to disabled prophecies that explain why the prophecy cannot be cast (e.g. not player hero's turn, not in combat, insufficient kudos, or insufficient health)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug in legacy progression level calculation logic where a negative discriminant in the quadratic formula was causing progression level to sometimes incorrectly be calculated as -2,147,483,648 instead of 0[/p][/*][*][p]Updated default difficulty level from level 0 to level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where hero info tooltip would sometimes show when an epithet was being hovered[/p][/*][*][p]Added a semitransparent circle indicator around units hovered over from the turn order queue[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Myrmidon speed from 5 to 6[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Owl health from 6 to 7[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Muse max damage from 10 to 12[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where hero epithet tooltips would sometimes display incorrectly during Odyssey setup[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.9 (Progression Update)
notes.content: [p][b]Hello![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch 1.0.9[/b] has just been released. This patch contains some significant new updates to gameplay systems, including a [b]legacy progression system[/b] and unlockable achievement [b]trophies[/b]. For full details on what has been added in this update, please see the detailed patch notes below![/p][p]The [b]legacy progression system[/b] tracks your [b]progress across playthroughs[/b], tracked separately for each patron. Eventually, this system will allow unlocking several new prophecies, epithets, and heroes. For now, [b]Odysseus[/b] starts unlocked, and [b]Achilles[/b] and [b]Atalanta[/b] must be unlocked by gaining a level with [b]Athena[/b] and [b]Zeus[/b], respectively. Higher difficulty levels increase the rate at which you gain legacy points, so [b]challenge yourself for increased rewards[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/e7d711b5464ca4110c809b62de19152b50e86e8d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]legacy progression system[/b] that tracks cross-run progress, allowing new gameplay content to be unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]unlockable trophies[/b], an achievement system that also rewards legacy progression points. Note: These are not setup as Steam Achievements in the demo, but will be in the full game release[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Unlocks[/b] to main menu, where unlockable game elements can be toggled and patron legacy levels can be viewed[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Catalog[/b] to main menu, where all heroes, units, prophecies, epithets, and trophies can be viewed along with brief descriptions of each.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]stat-tracking system[/b], recording progress within and across playthroughs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved graphics for [b]Owl [/b]unit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed bug[/b] [b]where enemy Muses[/b] were not able to buff adjacent allies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed bug[/b] that occurred when attempting to hover over unit detail [b]tooltips during odyssey setup[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, feel free to comment or contact us if you have any questions or feedback. Hope you [b]enjoy the latest improvements[/b]! [/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.8
notes.content: [p][b]Hello![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch 1.0.8 [/b]is now live. Patch 1.0.8 includes a new crisis log, recording every action taken during a crisis. This should make it much easier to track everything happening during battles![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/df9e16216c2f587ea22fbefa64b0ca510d61e33a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The patch also adds graphics improvements for several Zeus units and a visual bugfix. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/5751f15c865c727cfdb674cd76a91f274b2db347.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where [b]Calydonian Boar [/b]and [b]Medea[/b] displayed at double the intended size[/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics for [b]Centaur[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics for [b]Muse[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics for [b]Pegasus[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics for [b]Minotaur[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Crisis Log[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Please enjoy[/b] the new additions![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Patch 1.0.7[/b] just went live. This patch brings a redesigned look for the [b]Harpy [/b]and [b]Eagle [/b]units! The patch also contains a few miscellaneous improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/7d1d3d1d3a1b61a9346b7f99346bf08f1fb79878.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved graphics for [b]Eagle[/b]
[*] Improved graphics for [b]Harpy[/b]
[*] Improved [b]consistency of AI[/b] damage calculations
[*] Fixed a bug where the 2nd fastest unit wouldn't show up correctly in the [b]turn order preview[/b]
[/list]

Hope you enjoy these updates!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Patch 1.0.6[/b] has just been released. This patch overhauls the graphics for two heroes, [b]Odysseus and Achilles![/b] The patch also brings a few polish improvements and bugfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/3a170c4dde6d9e04f20b1134c01a854b87df8865.png[/img]

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved graphics for [b]Achilles.[/b]
[*] Improved graphics for [b]Odysseus.[/b]
[*] Added new [b]sound effect for fire breathing[/b] attacks.
[*] [b]Updated how hero epithets are applied[/b] to allied units. This fixes a bug where the Lion-Hearted wasn't correctly increasing army health. This change also causes hero buffs and debuffs to display both during and outside of battles.
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]unit swap and tutorial sounds[/b] were playing on the Music audio bus rather than the Sound Effects audio bus.
[*]Added labels to reroll and health boon previews indicating the exact amount of rerolls/health to be granted as rewards.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/3d510dc9ffcc5e439d0a1802f0a2329830b4f44f.png[/img]

[b]Please enjoy[/b] the new changes!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Greetings![/b]

[b]Patch 1.0.5 [/b] is live, bringing [b]two new Climax encounters[/b] and many [b]user experience improvements[/b]!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]  
[*] Added new Phase 1 Climax option: [b]Striges, cursed bloodthirsty owls[/b].  
[*] Added new Phase 3 Climax option: [b]Medea, the cunning sorceress[/b].  
[*] [b]Improved look and feel of buttons[/b] and background panels.  
[*] Fixed an issue where music transitions would wrongly be extended when multiple actions were performed in rapid succession.  
[*] [b]Improved formatting of boon previews[/b] in scene selection.  
[*] Updated styling of dialog titles.  
[*] Updated icon for Climax encounters.  
[*] Allowed right-clicking the active unit panel during a crisis to pull up the full unit info display.  
[*] [b]Capped max FPS[/b] to 60 to limit CPU/GPU usage.  
[*] Fixed an issue with hotkey bindings where the [b]"Escape"[/b] key could not be bound.  
[*] Added [b]fullscreen support[/b] – the default gameplay setting is now fullscreen, with a settings toggle to revert to Windowed mode.  
[*] Added a [b]setting to hide unit "Action Status"[/b] icons during combat.  
[/list]  

Thank you for trying out the demo!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Patch 1.0.4[/b] adds a few new settings options to improve the game's playability, along with some balance updates and performance improvements.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]  
[*] Added setting for [b]adjusting the speed of combat animations.[/b]
[*] [b]Improved alignment of tooltips[/b] for epithets and patron synergies.
[*] Updated look of [b]title logo[/b].
[*] [b]Added fallback when loading settings[/b], to allow game recovery from an invalid settings file.
[*] [b]Reduced install size[/b] by removing unused resources from builds.  
[*] Updated [b]"Hide Tutorial" button[/b] to disappear when in-game tutorial notifications are already disabled. 
[*] [b]Updated layout of tutorial popups[/b].  
[*] Added support for configuring [b]custom hotkey bindings[/b] under settings menu.  
[*] Updated proportions of [b]Myrmidon [/b]unit.  
[*] Added [b]caching for loaded unit images[/b], significantly reducing loading times between actions.  
[*] [b]Halved ammo count[/b] of most ranged units to make ammo stats more relevant.  
[*] Added [b]color balancing[/b].  
[*] Added special [b]tooltip for Wait button[/b] during unit placement to indicate the effects of waiting during this phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/8e6168bd3f8728058d46ee08c4258aba71e7a896.png[/img]

Let us know what you think of the changes! Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]New Hero: Atalanta! Plus Some Additional Updates[/b]

Hello everyone!

Biggest news first — [b]Atalanta, the Arcadian Huntress[/b], has been added as a new playable hero! Atalanta famously won the Calydonian boar hunt by wounding the boar with an arrow. Her unique hero talent, [b]"First Shot"[/b], makes her the only hero with a ranged attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/10c0212c94874e2f78aa3daf4d41d2d13f64892c.png[/img]

Work continues on future content and polish improvements. For now, please enjoy the following changes!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added new hero: [b]Atalanta, the Arcadian Huntress[/b].
[*] Reduced [b]Basilisk’s[/b] health from [b]27 → 25[/b].
[*] Increased [b]Cretan Archer’s[/b] health from [b]25 → 30[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug where damage totals were incorrectly displayed for units receiving collateral damage.
[*] Renamed [b]Artemis’s[/b] synergy to [b]"Wild Huntress"[/b].
[*] Added a [b]Settings[/b] menu link in the pause menu.
[*] Created a higher resolution asset for [b]Myrmidon[/b], as part of a planned touch-up for all unit graphics.
[*] Added a [b]gradient background[/b] to hero health and epithet displays.
[*] Added a [b]stylized title logo[/b] to the main menu.
[*] Added [b]game version info[/b] to the credits display.
[/olist]

As always, your feedback is incredibly helpful in shaping the game! If you have thoughts or run into any issues, feel free to post in the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3227320/discussions/]community hub[/url][/b] or reach out via email at [b]team@seapanda.xyz[/b].

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Thanks for playing the demo for [b]Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey[/b]! This update brings a mix of balance changes, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes.

[b]Changes & Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new crisis topography: [b]Reverse Ambush[/b].
[*] Added a more comprehensive preview of boons associated with each crisis.
[*] Fixed an issue where undo/redo buttons wouldn’t display correctly on Steam Deck.
[*] Added support for [b]right-clicking units during crisis scene selection[/b] to view their full information.
[*] Added support for [b]right-clicking units on the post-crisis summary screen[/b] to see their details.
[*] Increased [b]Barbarian's health[/b] from [b]5 → 6[/b].
[*] Renamed [b]Arachnid's "Slowing Shots"[/b] ability to [b]"Ensnare"[/b].
[*] Renamed [b]Sorceress's "Fire Shots"[/b] ability to [b]"Explosive"[/b].
[*] Reduced [b]Amazon's health[/b] from [b]50 → 45[/b] and damage from [b]12-18 → 12-16[/b].
[*] Increased [b]Arachnid's value[/b] from [b]100 → 110[/b].
[*] Increased [b]Huntress's health[/b] from [b]3 → 4[/b].
[*] Reduced [b]Hoplite's value[/b] from [b]70 → 65[/b].
[/list]

Your feedback continues to be incredibly helpful in shaping the game! If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3227320/discussions/]community hub[/url] or reach out via email at [b]team@seapanda.xyz[/b].

More updates are on the way as development continues. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Thank you[/b] for trying out the demo for [b]Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey[/b]! This patch makes a few small improvements to balance, UI, and sound effects.

[list]
[*] Halved the amount of drachma granted from rerolling with the [b]Circumspect[/b] epithet
[*] Significantly increased the amount of health for the phase 4 enemy hero [b]Talos[/b]
[*] Added new crisis topography: [b]Bottleneck[/b]
[*] Increased the volume of many sound effects
[*] Increased the size of the tutorial icon, and altered the tutorial hint sound effect to be more noticeable
[*] Added a note to the pause menu indicating that progress is automatically saved after every action
[*] Added some key bindings for waiting and defending in a crisis. A dialog was added to the settings menu listing these default key bindings. (Adding support for customizable key bindings is planned in a future update)
[/list]

I hope you are enjoying the demo! If you have any feedback, please feel free to create a thread in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3227320/discussions/]community hub[/url] or email me at team@seapanda.xyz ! I will continue to update this demo until the full release of [b]Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey[/b], so stay tuned!
